in_marathi.name: Dipjyoti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of the Dip (Diya)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dipjyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dipjyoti is a Sanskrit name that means 'Light of the Dip (Diya)'. In Hindu mythology, a dip is a small earthenware container used to hold oil or ghee for the purpose of offering a prayer or performing a ritual. The light of a dip signifies the presence of the deity and the removal of darkness in one's life.
